known_bugs: Physical device verification is still required for the expanded build.
Outer districts are generated procedurally and currently use primitive meshes rather than authored high-resolution assets.
Traffic and NPC simulation still need performance/behavior tuning in the outer districts.
Large authored asset packs still require an external high-storage workspace.
Expanded factory scene needs Android runtime regression verification after the world.gd process merge.
archive_policy: one archive from canonical project directory; never nest previous archives
asset_scale_target: approximately 200GB only if technically and legally supportable; never use filler data
recovery_rule: Never modify the proven playable boot path and feature activation simultaneously; every feature batch must pass Android build plus core boot regression checks.
